ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between dominant low-intensity (black) pixels and high-intensity (white) specular highlights; approximately 90% low-intensity coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous white patches observed on the inner fluke margins near the notch and scattered along the trailing edge; significant specular reflection prevents definitive 2D coordinate mapping of pigmentation across the central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 35-degree V-shaped notch; depth extends approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke height into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Prominent irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-8 pixels along the trailing edge of both lobes; distinct peaks visible against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves along the trailing edge, tapering toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast reddish-brown and white circular clusters (approx. 15-20 pixel diameter) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized reddish-brown protrusions on the distal tips of flukes consistent with epibiont attachment.
